title: [CHORE]: Plugin bindings payload hardening — restrict caller-overridable config keys
reasoning:
### 📝 Summary

`POST /v1/tools/plugin_bindings` currently accepts a free-form `config: Dict[str, Any]` per policy. Any key the caller sends is stored verbatim and merged into the per-tenant plugin config at runtime. There's no distinction between config that belongs at the gateway/operator layer and config that's genuinely meant to be set per (team, tool, plugin) by the caller.

This works, but it leaves the binding API with a wider responsibility than it really needs. Worth tightening.

### 🤔 Background

The binding API was introduced in #4068 with typed Pydantic schemas per plugin — each plugin had a known set of fields.

#4286 removed those per-plugin schemas, for sound architectural reasons: plugin contracts live in `cpex-plugins`, not in CF, so CF shouldn't have to know which plugins exist or what their config shape is. After that change, `config` became a fully open `Dict[str, Any]` that CF persists verbatim.
